name: ASMARATY G-100 Super Yacht
description: Discover the ASMARATY G-100, a super yacht designed to bring together refined luxury, spacious living and sophisticated marine engineering. With three expansive decks, elegant interiors and generous outdoor entertaining areas, the G-100 creates an exceptional setting for life on the water.
highlights: Spacious Three-Deck Design: Generous indoor & outdoor living with panoramic sea views
Refined Interior Living: Sunlit main salon, formal dining area & elegant lounges
Private Accommodation: Owner's cabin, forward VIP, 2 guest cabins & separate crew (5+2 / 12+5 berths)
Elevated Flybridge Experience: Social gatherings, sunbeds, bar & optional hot tub
Advanced Marine Systems: 2 × 1,600 hp MTU engines, ZF gearbox & 24-ton AC chiller

name: ASMARATY G77 Luxury Yacht
subtitle: Spacious Three-Deck Design & Exceptional Comfort
description: Step into a world of luxury aboard the ASMARATY G77. Featuring spacious interiors, a generous cockpit, and a welcoming flybridge, this luxury yacht combines elegant design with comfort and functionality. The main deck features an open-plan salon and formal dining area, surrounded by large side windows that fill the interior with natural light. With generous space across three decks, the G77 offers an inviting setting for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying time on the water.
highlights: Spacious Three-Deck Layout: Generous cockpit, welcoming flybridge & open-plan salon with formal dining
Sunlit Panoramic Interiors: Large side windows offering abundant natural light throughout the main deck
Owner & VIP Accommodation: Owner's cabin with ensuite & walk-in wardrobe, forward VIP & twin guest cabins (4+2 / 8+3 berths)
Dedicated Crew Quarters: Accommodation with two beds, dedicated galley and separate private bathroom
Elevated Flybridge Living: Sunbeds, bar, second steering station, optional hot tub & hydraulic stern platform
Standard Marine Engineering: GRP hull, 2 × 600–1200 HP inboard engines, 210,000 BTU AC & 28 kVA marine generator
accommodation: Owner's cabin with double bed, ensuite bathroom, and walk-in wardrobe. Forward VIP cabin with additional storage, twin guest berths, dedicated crew quarters (two beds, galley) and separate crew bathroom.

name: ASMARATY G-66 Luxury Yacht
subtitle: Refined Luxury. Exceptional Comfort.
description: Discover the ASMARATY G-66, a luxury yacht designed for memorable experiences on the water. Its elegant exterior, spacious interiors and welcoming flybridge create a refined setting for relaxation, entertaining and private escapes. Enjoy an open-plan salon, formal dining space, generous outdoor seating and thoughtfully designed private accommodation with large windows that bring natural light into the interior.
highlights: Elegant Interior Spaces: Spacious salon with comfortable seating, natural light & open-plan layout
Comfortable Private Accommodation: Owner's cabin, forward VIP & guest cabins (4+2 / 8+2 berths)
Flybridge Living: Elevated outdoor space designed for relaxing, socialising & taking in panoramic views
Outdoor Entertaining: Generous cockpit and outdoor seating areas welcoming family & guests
Practical Onboard Features: Integrated monitoring, navigation equipment & hydraulic stern platform

name: ASMARATY G-50 Luxury Motor Yacht
subtitle: Compact Elegance. Exceptional Comfort.
description: Discover the ASMARATY G-50, a luxury motor yacht designed to bring comfort, style and memorable experiences together. Its spacious salon, welcoming cockpit and flybridge create versatile spaces for relaxing, dining and enjoying time on the water.
highlights: Open-Plan Salon: Comfortable lounge seating, dedicated dining area & broad windows bringing natural light
Comfortable Accommodation: Forward owner's cabin and guest accommodation offering privacy and storage
Flybridge Living: Elevated outdoor space with comfortable seating and a second steering station
Outdoor Relaxation: Welcoming cockpit and generous deck areas for spending time with family and guests
Practical Onboard Features: Navigation equipment, integrated monitoring & optional hydraulic stern platform
